name: Quest Diagnostics

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Quest Diagnostics logo 2015.png), 562x177 px

description: Quest runs a network of clinical laboratories that tests patient samples for doctors, hospitals and employers, and reports the results. Roughly 98 percent of 2025 revenue ($10.8B of $11.0B) is Diagnostic Information Services, which is per-test billing; the rest is Diagnostic Solutions, a life-insurance risk-assessment business (ExamOne) and healthcare IT. Revenue is volume times a price per test, so the drivers are requisitions (test orders), revenue per requisition, and which party pays: 43 percent of 2025 revenue was billed to healthcare insurers, 17 percent to government payers and 37 percent to 'client payers'. Recent volume growth includes new hospital relationships, such as a Michigan lab entity with Corewell Health formed in January 2026 (Q2 2026 10-Q).

gics.note: SEC SIC code 8071 (Services-Medical Laboratories). The same sub-industry label covers CVS Health (pharmacy, PBM and insurer) and Labcorp in the same source, showing how wide the box is.

hq.note: 500 Plaza Drive, Secaucus, NJ 07094 (SEC EDGAR business address)

employees.note: About 57,000 employees globally including about 6,800 at LifeLabs (FY2025 10-K text: 'approximately 57,000 employees globally (including LifeLabs' approximately 6,800)'). Wikipedia infobox shows 65,000 (2026): see conflicts.

businessLines.name: Diagnostic Information Services (DIS)
businessLines.shareBasis: Share of revenue = 10,785 / 11,035. Share of profit = 1,829 / (1,829 + 32) segment operating income before corporate costs.
businessLines.how: Each physician order (a requisition) is billed per test to whoever pays: health insurers, government programs (Medicare and Medicaid), or 'client payers' billed directly. Revenue moves with requisition volume and revenue per requisition; in 2025 volume rose 12.3% and price per requisition 0.1%, and in Q2 2026 volume rose 13.1% while revenue per requisition fell 2.8% because of business mix with new hospital relationships such as Corewell Health.
businessLines.description: Clinical testing services: routine, advanced and anatomic pathology tests ordered by physicians, hospitals and employers, run in Quest laboratories and reported through patient service centers and IT.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $1,630M; before $305M of general corporate costs

businessLines.name: Diagnostic Solutions (DS)
businessLines.how: Life insurers pay per applicant for exams, data and lab work that support underwriting; the IT businesses sell software to healthcare providers. Volume follows life-insurance applications.
businessLines.description: Risk assessment services for life insurers (ExamOne, described in the 10-K as the largest provider of risk assessment services to the life insurance industry in North America: underwriting support, data gathering, paramedical exams and clinical lab testing) and healthcare information technology businesses.
